features: Premium Soft Touch Finish: Meet the boAt APEX PB332 MagnaCharge, a power bank designed to feel as good as it performs. Its sleek soft-touch body offers a premium in-hand feel, while the anti-slip grip ensures a secure, comfortable hold every time you reach for it.

Built-in Foldable Stand: Watch videos, attend meetings, or browse comfortably while your device charges. The integrated foldable stand securely supports your smartphone in both portrait and landscape orientations, delivering a convenient hands-free viewing experience at your desk, bedside, or while travelling.

15W Magnetic Wireless Charging: Experience effortless wireless charging with the boAt Apex PB332 MagnaCharge. The powerful magnetic charging surface securely aligns compatible devices for stable and efficient 15W wireless charging, reducing charging interruptions while keeping your device firmly in place throughout the session.

MagnaCharge Ring Included: The included MagnaCharge Ring enables magnetic alignment for compatible wireless charging devices without built-in magnets. Simply attach the ring to your device or compatible case to enjoy secure magnetic attachment and a more stable wireless charging experience.

22.5W 2-Way Wired Fast Charging: Power your devices faster with up to 22.5W wired fast charging. Supporting QC 3.0, Power Delivery (PD), and PPS protocols, the Apex PB332 quickly charges compatible smartphones and also recharges itself efficiently through the Type-C 2-Way port, helping minimise charging downtime.
